claims.text: The manual describes the warning symbol in the tell-tales as an indicator that glows whenever a vehicle component faults.

The manual lists the engine MIL separately: it stays continuously ON in case of an EMS malfunction, and the ABS lamp separately lights up for an ABS system malfunction. These are different indicators from the general warning symbol.

This partly answers your question. The retrieved manual information does not establish which exact part has failed when the general warning symbol is on; the symbol only indicates that some vehicle component has a fault.
